full_prompt: Medium close-up of an Ethiopian mother in her late 40s, rich warm dark-brown skin, neat shuruba cornrows, speaking tenderly with soft wise eyes looking off-camera to the right, white handwoven cotton habesha kemis with a green embroidered neckline and a thin white netela shawl loosely over one shoulder.
